name: CoverFlow
overview: Rediscover your Jellyfin collection with a perspective CoverFlow view.
description: Independent early-preview Jellyfin Web extension for albums, movies, TV series, books and comics. Requires the Jellyfin 12-compatible JavaScript Injector plugin. Native TV clients are not supported.

versions.changelog: Fixes music artist labels displaying [object Object] by reading modern Name/Id pairs and legacy strings. Uses artist-item and track-artist fallbacks when album artists are missing. Explicitly requests total catalog counts.

Follows Jellyfin interface language using native translations and live updates. Localizes common labels, counts, accessibility and menu matching; adds action icons with translated tooltips. CoverFlow-specific messages have Italian/English fallbacks.
Adds an A-Z/# CoverFlow index and shared current-item anchors across Grid, List and CoverFlow, including native page recovery within the same library/folder. Preserves sorting and unrelated filters.

Fixes repeated native sortBy parameters discarding the primary sort field. Follows committed Jellyfin sort settings even with cached results while preserving the selected item and per-library view choices.

Remembers CoverFlow, Grid and List independently for each library. Restores the correct view on navigation, revisits and reloads while preserving Jellyfin native Grid/List settings and existing CoverFlow choices.
Fixes the native MUI View menu integration and follows Jellyfin sorting while preserving the selected item across pages, direction changes and comic-folder navigation.
